https://snkrdunk.com/apparels/138599.headline: Ask up 18% in a week to ¥34,700, 16% above where sales clear
https://snkrdunk.com/apparels/138599.text:
What's happening: The lowest PSA10 ask rose from ¥29,400 to ¥34,700 in a week while my tier index fell about 4%. Recent sales still cleared around ¥29,800 (latest prints up to ¥33,000), and only 8 of 20 listings sit within 15% of the ask.

Why: Most likely the cheapest copies sold and sellers relisted higher; that is a reading of the data, not a confirmed cause. I did not research external news this run.

For you: The ask is above the Buy line (¥29,500) and far above your ¥26,000 limit, and the correction rule keeps this a Watch.

Watch: whether sales keep printing above ¥30,000 or drift back to ¥29,000-29,800, which would make the ask look stretched.

https://snkrdunk.com/apparels/387059.headline: Ask jumped 7% while the rest of the market fell, on thinner trading

Sales slowed sharply, from about 7.5 a day to 2.5, so the rise looks like sellers pulling cheaper listings rather than new demand. That is a guess from the data, not a confirmed cause. The ask sits above the Buy line (¥38,000) and your limit (¥35,000), so there is nothing to do; watch whether sales pick back up before treating this as a new floor.

https://snkrdunk.com/apparels/585221.headline: Lowest ask 11% under recent sales, but price is still sliding

What's happening: The lowest PSA10 ask is ¥100,000, about 11% under the ¥112,000 median of recent sales. The sales print sequence has stepped down from ¥120,000–125,000 on 09-25 to ¥97,900–105,000 over the last few days, and trading is about 2.9 sales a day.

https://snkrdunk.com/apparels/224087.headline: Greninja ask ¥48,000 is 12% above sales; slab premium 28% below norm
https://snkrdunk.com/apparels/224087.text:
What's happening: The lowest PSA10 ask is ¥48,000, 12% above the recent sales median of ¥42,900, and only 10 of 20 listings sit within 15% of it. The pokeca-chart slab premium (PSA10 over raw) was 1.25x on 2026-09-16 against a 6-month norm of 1.73x.

Why: Sales cluster at ¥41,000-44,000 while the lowest ask sits higher; a thin cheap end tends to mean the next sale prints above the old low. A low premium means the slab is cheap relative to the raw card, not that the ask is cheap. I did not research external news this run.

For you: ¥48,000 is above the Buy line (¥43,000) and your ¥37,000 limit, so it stays a Watch.

Watch: sales printing back at ¥41,000-43,000 or the ask resetting below ¥44,000.

https://snkrdunk.com/apparels/100567.headline: Slab premium at 1.07x vs a usual 1.76x, ask 8% above sales
https://snkrdunk.com/apparels/100567.text:
What's happening: The lowest PSA10 ask is ¥143,000, about 8% above the ¥132,000 median of recent sales, and 12 of 20 listings sit within 15% of it. Sales are running at about 3.9 a day, with prints between ¥126,800 and ¥142,000 over the past week.

Why: The slab sells at only 1.07x the raw price against a six-month norm of about 1.76x (pokeca-chart, 2026-09-28), so raw is priced high relative to the slab, or the slab is cheap. This is a reading of the data; I found no reprint or supply news for this set.

For you: The ask is just under the Ceiling (¥145,000), well above the Buy line (¥128,000) and your ¥90,000 limit. The correction rule keeps this at Watch.

Watch: Whether sales keep clearing near ¥130,000, and whether the raw price falls toward the slab (which would lift the premium back).

https://snkrdunk.com/apparels/455596.headline: Umbreon ask ¥69,500, up 7% in a week against a falling market
https://snkrdunk.com/apparels/455596.text:
What's happening: The lowest PSA10 ask moved from ¥65,000 to ¥69,500 in a week while my tier index fell about 4%. All 20 listings sit within 15% of the ask, and sales run about 11 a day, so the book is deep and liquid.

Why: A deep, active book suggests a real bid rather than a thin-market jump, but this is my reading, not a confirmed cause; I did not research external news this run.

Watch: whether the ask holds near ¥69,000 or slips back toward your limit as the index keeps correcting.
